title: Integrator, Second-Order
text: Second-order integration of input signal, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {State name x} sets Name for state x; {Initial condition source x} sets the source of initial condition for state x, {Initial condition x} sets the initial condition of state x, {Limit x} limits values of state x, {Upper limit x} sets the upper limit of state x, {Lower limit x} sets the lower limit of state x, {Wrap x} enables wrapping of x, {Wrapped upper value x} sets the upper value for wrapping, {Wrapped lower value x} sets the lower value for wrapping, {Absolute tolerance x} sets the absolute tolerance for computing state x, {Initial condition source dx/dt} sets the source of initial condition for state dx/dt, {Initial condition dx/dt} sets the initial condition of state dx/dt, {Limit dx/dt} limits values of state dx/dt, {Upper limit dx/dt} sets the upper limit of state, {Lower limit dx/dt} sets the lower limit of state, {Absolute tolerance dx/dt} sets the absolute tolerance for computing state, {State name dx/dt} sets the name for state dx/dt, {External reset} sets the reset states to their initial conditions, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Reinitialize dx/dt when x reaches saturation} sets the reset dx/dt when x reaches saturation, {Ignore state limits and the reset for linearization} sets the ignore state limits and external reset and {Show output} sets the output ports. Values come from the instance.
